headline: MSCI drops Strategy from its index

scenes.vo: The biggest corporate Bitcoin holder is getting kicked out of a major stock index. Here's what changed.
On Wednesday, MSCI said it will remove Strategy from its main American stock index at the close of November thirtieth. Japan's Metaplanet is also being dropped from a small cap index.
Here's why traders are watching it. Funds that track the index must sell their Strategy shares. JPMorgan once estimated about two point eight billion dollars of selling from a move like this.
The catch? That estimate was based on an older MSCI proposal, so the real number could differ. And Strategy is not selling any Bitcoin because of this.
Here's what happens next. Watch Strategy's share price into November thirtieth, and whether other index providers follow MSCI's rule.
